outline:
先修課程:4402014或負責教授同意
一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導；對流原理，強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式；輻射熱傳遞；凝結與沸騰；熱交換器；熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction- Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.
schedule:
第01週 Introduction to Heat Transfer
第02週 Introduction to Conduction
第03週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction without Thermal Energy Generation
第04週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction with Thermal Energy Generation
第05週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction / Extended Surfaces
第06週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / The Heat Equation and Methods of Solution
第07週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / The Heat Equation and Methods of Solution
第08週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / Finite-Difference Equations and Solutions
第09週 Midterm Exam
第10週 Transient Conduction / The Lumped Capacitance Method
第11週 Fundamental Concepts of Convection
第12週 Force convection External flow
第13週 Force convection External flow
第14週 Force convection Internal flow
第15週 Force convection Internal flow
第16週 Free convection
第17週 Free convection
第18週 Final Exam
scorePolicy:
Homework, quiz and Attendance 30%
Midterm Exam 35%
Final Exam 35%
materials: Incropera's Principles of Heat and Mass Transfer, Frank P. Incropera, David P. Dewitt, Theodore L. Bergman, Adrienne S. Lavine, Global Edition, John Wiley & Sons.
consultation: Tuesday and Wednesday, 9 AM to 12 AM @ Integrated Technology Complex Building, Room 113. Available after class or by appointment at other times. No homework assistance by e-mail.
